title: Feature Flags (v2)
description: Response body for GET /api/v2/runtime/flags (agent) and GET /api/v1/runtime/flags (gateway pass-through) per SPEC-072 R-4: the authenticated, curated feature-flag inventory. Discovery-safe by construction — each entry is a stable snake_case name plus a boolean (and optional human label), never a secret value; a flag whose knob is a secret reports only configured / not configured. Distinct from the unauthenticated GET /api/v2/runtime probe (agent-runtime-metadata.schema.json), which carries no flags and is unchanged.

feature_flags.description: The curated allowlist of deployment toggles. Always-on invariants with no knob are deliberately absent.

enabled.description: Whether the flag is on for this deployment.

label.description: Optional human-readable label for the portal panel.
